title: Terminal
clipboardHint: Paste directly in the terminal with {{shortcut}}.

exit.error: The shell ended with an error (exit code {{code}}).

failure.notAllowed: No further terminal can be opened right now

clearLabel: Clear scrollback – the output scrolled out of view
hide: Hide terminal – the shell keeps running
exitHint: Tab and Esc go to the shell – F6 leaves the terminal
tooMuchOutput: Too much output to read aloud. Use the arrow keys to read it line by line.

confirm.restartBody: The shell is ended – along with everything running in it. The previous output disappears.
confirm.endBody: The shell is ended – along with everything running in it. The output is lost; a new shell starts the next time you open it.
confirm.closeTabNamed: Close tab “{{name}}” and end the terminal?
confirm.closeTab: Close tab and end the terminal?
confirm.closeTabBody: The terminal of this tab is still running a shell you worked in. It ends with the tab – along with everything running in it.
confirm.closeSessionBody: The session ends – along with everything running in it. Its output is lost.
